note: One invented runway look changed a step at a time in two directions, each picture read by the clothes reader (adtone/flex.py). Masks are fractions of the picture's width and height.

start.prompt: A full-length photograph from a fashion show. A woman walks straight towards the camera along a pale stone runway, centred in a tall portrait frame and seen whole from head to toe, with clear space above her head and below her feet. Behind her is a plain off-white wall. Soft, even, diffuse light. She wears a plain mid-grey shift dress of matte woven wool that ends at the knee, with long fitted sleeves and a simple round neckline, and plain black flat shoes. Her dark hair is pulled back smoothly into a low bun, with her ears showing. Bare legs. No jewellery, no earrings, no necklace, no hat, no belt, no bag, no glasses. Arms relaxed at her sides. Calm, neutral expression. Natural skin texture, realistic proportions, sharp focus, professional runway photography. No audience, no other people, no text, no logos.
start.negative: blurry, out of focus, cropped head, cropped feet, cut-off limbs, extra limbs, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face, cartoon, illustration, painting, 3d render, text, watermark, logo, audience, crowd, other people, jewellery, earrings, necklace, hat, sunglasses, glasses, bag, belt, pattern, print
start.why: the plainest reading of the eight (straight, soft cut, casual, 3 of 5), the figure whole with room on every side

decorated.prompt: Add jewellery: a short, bold gold chain necklace sitting close around the base of her neck, and small gold drop earrings. Keep her face, hair, dress and everything else exactly the same.

Replace the dress with two pieces in the same mid-grey matte wool: a plain fitted top with long sleeves, tucked in at her natural waist, and a pleated skirt that flares out from the waist and ends at mid-calf. Keep the necklace, earrings, hands, shoes, face and everything else exactly the same.

Make the skirt sheer: layers of soft pleated grey tulle with her legs faintly visible through it, ending at mid-calf as before. Keep the top, the necklace, her hands and everything else exactly the same.
Embroider the top densely with small grey glass beads over the bodice and the sleeves. Keep the necklace, the earrings, the skirt, her hands and everything else exactly the same.
Add a narrow belt in the same grey cloth at her waist, tied in a small bow at the front. Keep everything else exactly the same.

plainer.prompt: Change the colour of the dress to black. Keep its shape, length, sleeves, folds and cloth exactly the same, and keep everything else exactly the same.

Replace the dress with a plain black top with long sleeves and wide, plain black trousers that fall to the floor and pool over plain black boots. Keep her face, hair, hands, pose and everything else exactly the same.

Add an oversized black wool coat worn open over the outfit, with very wide, sharp, padded shoulders and long sleeves to the wrists, falling to below the knee. Keep her face, hair, hands, the trousers, the boots and everything else exactly the same.
Make the coat smooth black leather with a soft sheen, keeping its shape, size and folds exactly the same. Keep everything else exactly the same.
Add dark wraparound sunglasses. Keep her face, hair and everything else exactly the same.

prep.what: the seated audience at the edges taken out
prep.prompt: Remove the seated people at the left and right edges of the picture, and the paper on the right. Continue the plain off-white wall and the pale stone floor in their place. Change nothing else.
